svg.aria-label: Skills. Mostly Flutter and Firebase for the apps, and TypeScript for the web and the servers. Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin. Backend and data: TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, REST APIs. Web: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, WebGL2, Electron. Testing and delivery: Flutter tests, Vitest, Playwright, Firebase Emulator Suite, GitHub Actions, App Store and Google Play releases. Also: Python, Java (working knowledge), Vertex AI and Gemini, MediaPipe, Git.
